name: Spawn Map by N2ls
summary: Editable native scene/place with seven fenced Plot5 areas, Empty Slot labels, checker/stud ground, layered perimeter walls and varied forest, savanna, jungle, desert, mountain, taiga, ocean, ruins and prehistoric vegetation/rock props. The supplied file contains 6,363 instances and no embedded scripts. This is map geometry, not a functioning tycoon or complete game.
install: Open the .rbxl with File > Open from File in Studio. Use Save As to make a working copy. To merge geometry into another place, select intended Workspace objects in Studio and copy them into Workspace; merge Lighting separately if desired. Keep internal models and transforms intact. Add your own SpawnLocation, plot ownership, collection/economy and gameplay scripts. Do not overwrite an existing game with this scene unintentionally.
limits: Static scene preview and limited local spawn check only. No plot ownership, collecting, saving, economy or gameplay scripts are supplied. No authored SpawnLocation was found in the file. Local Play spawned at approximately (0, 5, 0); this is not proof of complete traversal or collision correctness. Galleries show grouped scene regions, not exhaustive isolated inspection of every prop copy. No mobile/gamepad or performance testing.
credit: Supplied filename attributes the map to N2ls. That attribution is retained without asserting independent authorship verification. Preserve embedded names and third-party/platform asset terms.
